OPERATION
  Set AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES from 10 to 60 in production payments.conf (PaymentsService).
  Review needed because: production.

WHY
  Restore the documented 60-minute authorization hold default so it exceeds the 15-minute capture delay, correcting the production 10-minute hold that causes E4021.
  Claim: E4021 means the authorization hold expired before capture; handling requires re-authorization then capture, and capture alone must not be retried.
    source lookup_error_code('E4021') (confidence high, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-04T02:09Z)
    the source returns: E4021: Payment authorization expired / Cause: The authorization hold lapsed before capture. / Handling: Re-authorize, then capture. Do not retry capture alone.
  Claim: For payments, AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES defaults to 60 and must exceed CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES to prevent authorization holds lapsing before capture.
    source get_config_schema('payments') (confidence high, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-04T02:09Z)
    the source returns: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES integer False 60 Minutes the provider holds an authorization. Must exceed CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES or holds lapse before capture.
  Claim: Production payments has AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES=10 and CAPTURE_DELAY_MINUTES=15.
    source read_config('production', 'payments') (confidence high, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-06T03:49Z)
    the source returns: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES=10
  Claim: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES configures how long RenewalsWorker renewal authorizations are held before capture.
    source trace_configuration('AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES') (confidence high, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-06T01:29Z)
    the source returns: RenewalsWorker: It is configured by AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES, which sets how long a renewal authorization is held before capture.
  Claim: Within two hops, payments has six affected dependents: OrderService, RenewalsWorker, BillingService, ReportingService, SearchService, and ApiGateway.
    source find_dependents('payments', max_depth=2) (confidence medium, coverage complete, changed 2026-11-06T01:29Z)
    the source returns: Resolved 'payments' to PaymentsService (also matched: PaymentsAPI). / 6 affected within 2 hops: / OrderService via OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  Note: weakest evidence confidence is medium.

AFFECTS
  RenewalsWorker: It is configured by AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES, which sets how long a renewal authorization is held before capture.
  6 affected within 4 hops:
  OrderService via OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  RenewalsWorker via RenewalsWorker -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  BillingService via BillingService -DEPENDS_ON-> OrderService then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  ReportingService via ReportingService -DEPENDS_ON-> OrderService then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  SearchService via SearchService -DEPENDS_ON-> OrderService then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  ApiGateway via ApiGateway -CALLS-> OrdersAPI (exposed by OrderService) then OrderService -CALLS-> PaymentsAPI (exposed by PaymentsService)
  Source: trace_configuration('AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES') (coverage complete)
  Source: find_dependents('PaymentsService', max_depth=4) (coverage complete)

REVERSIBLE
  The value: yes. Setting AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES back to 10 restores it.
  Requests handled while the new value is live: no.

ALTERNATIVES
  1. Apply to staging only and watch it before production.
  2. Do nothing: AUTH_HOLD_MINUTES stays 10 in production.
